crossRefs.note: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for…
So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants, and stewards of God’s mysteries.
If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove…
making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.
Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which…

translations.web: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
translations.bsb: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
translations.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall ➔ not all sleep, but we shall ➔ all be changed,
translations.asv: Behold, I tell you a mystery: We all shall not sleep, but we shall all be changed,
